fusions.name: Heaving Line
fusions.desc: Hurls a weighted line at an enemy up to 8 tiles away; it deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range, and is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Wrench at the Helm
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up: a wrenching grip that deals 8 damage and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Every Crew Pulling
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles deals 15% more damage for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Steady at the Wheel
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
